description: An IMMUTABLE snapshot of one CRM Automation Rule's decision-relevant definition (criteria + ordered actions), content-addressed by definition_hash. A running execution binds to a version, never to the mutable rule - so editing a rule can never re-route, duplicate or orphan a lead already executing it. Minted by automation.versions on rule save; runtime data, never seeded (A.17).

fields.label: Rule
fields.description: Reporting only - the executor never reads it. A force-deleted rule leaves this dangling by design; the version still executes.

fields.label: Version No
fields.description: 1, 2, 3 ... per rule. For humans; identity is the content hash.

fields.label: Is Current
fields.description: The definition a NEW fire binds to. Exactly one per rule; reverting a rule to an older definition re-flags that version rather than minting a duplicate. The only mutable column here - the frozen definition itself never changes.

fields.label: Action Count
fields.description: Actions in the frozen definition (both lanes).

fields.label: Definition Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the canonical payload. Unique per rule - an idempotent save mints nothing.

fields.label: Definition (JSON)
fields.description: The frozen definition: on_doctype, event, grain, criteria, and every action in order - each carrying its child-row name, the identity the migration prefix check compares.

name: CRM Automation Rule Version
